G01.title: Sentence building: verb second, inversion, Satzklammer
G01.cando: I can build clear main clauses in the right order, also after an opening time or place phrase.

G02.title: Perfekt and Präteritum in conversation
G02.cando: I can talk about past events naturally: Perfekt for most verbs, Präteritum for sein, haben and modal verbs.

G03.title: Subordinate clauses: weil, dass, wenn, obwohl
G03.cando: I can give reasons, report content and set conditions with the verb at the end.

G04.title: Modal verbs and everyday requests
G04.cando: I can ask, offer and decline in everyday work situations.

G05.title: Konjunktiv II: wishes, suggestions, politeness
G05.cando: I can make polite requests, suggestions and hypothetical statements.

G06.title: Relative clauses (nominative, accusative, dative)
G06.cando: I can describe people, things and situations with a relative clause.

G07.title: Adjective endings
G07.cando: I can use adjective endings correctly in common phrases.

G08.title: Case and prepositions: two-way and fixed combinations
G08.cando: I can choose the right case after common prepositions and verb-preposition pairs.

G09.title: Reflexive and separable verbs
G09.cando: I can use reflexive and separable verbs in main and subordinate clauses.

G10.title: Passive: process and result
G10.cando: I can say what is done without naming who does it.

G11.title: Infinitive clauses: zu, um ... zu, ohne ... zu
G11.cando: I can express purpose and attitude with infinitive clauses.

G12.title: Time links: als, wenn, seit, bevor, nachdem, während
G12.cando: I can order events in time and choose between als and wenn.

G13.title: Connectors in main clauses: deshalb, trotzdem, außerdem
G13.cando: I can link ideas across sentences with the verb in second position.

G14.title: Comparison: je ... desto and degrees
G14.cando: I can compare and grade things precisely.

G15.title: Verb-preposition pairs and pronominal adverbs (darauf, worüber)
G15.cando: I can ask and answer with da- and wo- words instead of repeating long phrases.

G16.title: Passive extended: modal verbs, state passive, man
G16.cando: I can use passive with modal verbs and tell a process from a state.

G17.title: Konjunktiv II of the past
G17.cando: I can talk about missed chances and regrets.

G18.title: Conditions: falls, sofern, es sei denn, unreal sentences
G18.cando: I can state conditions and exceptions precisely.

G19.title: Reasons, results, aims: da, zumal, sodass, damit
G19.cando: I can justify decisions and state consequences and goals.

G20.title: Contrast and concession: zwar ... aber, während, wohingegen
G20.cando: I can weigh two sides and concede a point before arguing my own.

G21.title: Genitive and prepositions with genitive: wegen, trotz, aufgrund
G21.cando: I can use genitive prepositions in formal speech and writing.

G22.title: Relative clauses extended: preposition, was, wo, genitive
G22.cando: I can build longer relative clauses without losing the thread.

G23.title: Verb-noun phrases and fixed expressions (Funktionsverbgefüge)
G23.cando: I can use typical formal verb-noun combinations instead of plain verbs.

G24.title: Modal particles: doch, mal, eben, halt, ja
G24.cando: I can soften or colour a sentence the way native speakers do.

G25.title: Discourse markers and conversation strategies
G25.cando: I can take time to think, change direction and correct myself smoothly.

G26.title: Politeness and register: du/Sie, formal and informal
G26.cando: I can adjust my language to the person and the situation.

G27.title: Word order in the middle field, stress and negation
G27.cando: I can place pronouns, time, place and negation naturally.

G28.title: Indirect speech: Konjunktiv I and substitutes
G28.cando: I can report what others said accurately and neutrally.

G29.title: Participial attributes and extended attributes
G29.cando: I can read and use compact noun phrases with participles.

G30.title: Nominalisation and nominal style
G30.cando: I can switch between verbal and nominal style to fit formal contexts.

G31.title: Reporting and referring: laut, zufolge, demnach
G31.cando: I can attribute information to sources and mark my distance.

G32.title: Nuance: lassen constructions, sein + zu, passive alternatives
G32.cando: I can express possibility and necessity without modal verbs.

G33.title: Arguing and weighing: supporting, limiting, concluding
G33.cando: I can build a balanced argument and draw a clear conclusion aloud.

G34.title: Precision: prefix verbs and word formation
G34.cando: I can pick the exact verb and derive related words.

SP02.title: Hungarian-speaker pitfalls: word order and prepositions

SP05.title: Understanding Swiss dialect: common patterns and words

SP06.title: Phone and Teams calls: openings, closings, repairs
